title: Strategic Transmission Expansion (STX)
summary: APS's public page for its Strategic Transmission Expansion portfolio. Names two current projects: the Cotton Transmission Corridor (Jojoba-Rudd 500kV + Panda-Freedom 230kV, ~53 mi, 2032; West Valley, Gila Bend/Buckeye/Goodyear/Avondale) and the Pinal Electrical Improvement Project (230kV, ~25 mi, Coolidge to Eloy, 2027 = Helios-Milligan, CEC 247). No investment figure; the 2032 date is older than the 2031 Jojoba-Rudd date in the 2026 plan.

findings.statement: Cotton Transmission Corridor = Jojoba-Rudd 500kV + Panda-Freedom 230kV, ~53 mi, in-service 2032 per the web page; purpose West Valley reliability and growth.
Pinal Electrical Improvement Project: 230kV, ~25 mi, Coolidge to Eloy, 2027; CEC 247 name for the Pinal Central-Milligan section of Helios-Milligan.

projects.name: Cotton Transmission Corridor
projects.poi: Jojoba-Rudd and Panda-Freedom, SW Maricopa County
